items.en: Pirelli has completed the total renewal of its cold-weather lineup with the launch of the Scorpion Winter 3, a third-generation winter tyre engineered specifically for SUVs and crossovers. Developed to address the heavier weight and higher centre of gravity characteristic of SUVs, a segment that now accounts for more than 50 per cent of the global automotive market according to S&P Global Mobility data, the tyre eliminates traditional performance compromises between snow grip, wet handling, comfort, and durability.
